title: What Happens to Your Body When You Exercise?
paragraphs: When you start to exercise, your body changes quickly. Your heart beats faster and you breathe more deeply. This sends more oxygen to your body.
Your muscles use this oxygen to make energy. After some minutes, you get warm and start to sweat. Sweat helps your body to stay cool.
Exercise also changes how you feel. The brain makes chemicals that can make you feel happier and less stressed. Many people also sleep better after exercise.
If you exercise often, your heart and muscles get stronger. Health experts say adults should do at least 150 minutes of activity every week, for example a fast walk.
